sections.title: Day 27 學習概覽
sections.markdown:
今天進入第四週的 **900+ 混合推論階段**。前幾天已練過圖表、多條件篩選、時序、例外與 Updated Information；今天把它們合併，要求你一次處理：

> **Listening：條件 → 圖表 → 意圖 → 下一步**  
> **Reading：原規則 → 更新資訊 → 例外 → 推論**

文法則進入條件副詞進階：**unless / once / as soon as / provided that / in case**。

目前沒有新的 Day 26 作答紀錄，因此不直接提高文章長度，而是提高「資訊整合層數」。今天建議 **90～100 分鐘**。

sections.title: ② 今日文法｜unless
sections.markdown:
`unless`：

> **除非／如果不**

可以理解為：

> if ... not

例如：

> The event will continue **unless it rains**.

≈

> The event will continue **if it does not rain**.

注意不要再加 not：

> unless it doesn't rain ❌

這通常會造成雙重否定。

sections.title: ③ provided that
sections.markdown:
意思：

> **只要／前提是**

例如：

> Employees may work remotely **provided that their managers approve**.

邏輯：

> manager approval = 必要條件

sections.title: ④ once
sections.markdown:
`once` 在條件／時間副詞子句中：

> **一旦……**

例如：

> We will process the payment **once we receive the invoice**.

順序：

> receive invoice  
> ↓  
> process payment

所以 `once` 很常出現在 TOEIC 流程題。

sections.title: ⑤ as soon as
sections.markdown:
意思：

> **一……就……**

> Please contact me **as soon as you receive the package**.

順序：

> package arrives  
> ↓ immediately  
> contact me

`once` 和 `as soon as` 很接近，但：

> **as soon as**

更強調「立即」。

sections.title: ⑥ in case
sections.markdown:
這個最容易跟 `if` 搞混。

> Take an umbrella **in case it rains**.

意思不是：

> 下雨之後再帶傘。

而是：

> **預防可能下雨，所以現在先帶傘。**

核心：

> **in case = 預防某件事可能發生**

sections.title: ⑦ if vs. in case
sections.markdown:
比較：

> Call me **if** there is a problem.

= 問題真的發生 → 打給我。

> Take my number **in case** there is a problem.

= 現在先留電話 → 預防未來有問題。

這個差異非常重要。

sections.title: ⑧ 未來事件中的現在式
sections.markdown:
高頻陷阱：

> I will call you as soon as I _____ the results.

(A) will receive  
(B) receive

答案：

**B**

時間／條件副詞子句談未來時，通常使用現在式：

> when I receive  
> once we finish  
> as soon as she arrives  
> if the manager approves  
> unless something changes

主句才用：

> will

sections.title: ⑨ Listening｜900+ 圖表＋意圖＋下一步
sections.markdown:
### Project Meeting Rooms

| Room | Capacity | Equipment | Available |
|---|---:|---|---|
| Cedar | 10 | Screen | 9–12 |
| Maple | 16 | Screen + Video | 9–1 |
| Pine | 24 | Screen + Video | 1–5 |
| Oak | 30 | Screen | 9–5 |

### Q1

Why is the speaker calling?

(A) To reserve a meeting room  
(B) To cancel a conference  
(C) To purchase video equipment  
(D) To change a hotel reservation

### Q2

Look at the table. Which room will most likely be selected?

(A) Cedar  
(B) Maple  
(C) Pine  
(D) Oak

### Q3

Why does the speaker say, “There's no reason to book anything larger”?

(A) The company wants to minimize unnecessary cost or space  
(B) More employees will attend later  
(C) Large rooms lack screens  
(D) The meeting has been shortened

聽力稿：

> Hi, I'm arranging Thursday's project review for fourteen employees. The meeting will run from ten until noon, and one of our contractors will join us by video. I see that several rooms are available, but there's no reason to book anything larger than necessary. Please reserve the smallest room that meets all of those requirements and send me the confirmation.

### 答案

**1A / 2B / 3A**

條件：

> 14 people  
> 10–12  
> video

Maple：

> 16 + video + 9–1

符合，而且是最小符合者。

下一步也有：

> **send confirmation**

這就是今天開始要求的第四層資訊。

sections.title: ⑩ Listening｜意圖＋下一步
sections.markdown:
### Q1

Why is the speaker calling?

(A) To discuss a contract  
(B) To order office furniture  
(C) To apply for a job  
(D) To cancel a trip

### Q2

What problem does the speaker mention?

(A) The price has increased  
(B) A deadline cannot be met  
(C) A document was lost  
(D) Payment was rejected

### Q3

What does the speaker want the listener to do?

(A) Cancel the project  
(B) Approve a revised schedule  
(C) Hire another contractor  
(D) Request a refund

聽力稿：

聽力稿：

> Hello, Ms. Wang. This is Peter from Kingston Construction. I'm calling about the renovation project. Because one of our material suppliers experienced an unexpected shipping delay, we won't be able to complete the work by October 8 as originally planned. We can finish everything by October 11 instead. I've emailed you a revised project schedule. Please review it and let me know whether the new completion date is acceptable.

答案：

注意同義：

≈

> **approve a revised schedule**

sections.title: ⑪ Listening｜圖表＋推論
sections.markdown:
### Delivery Options

| Service | Arrival | Fee |
|---|---|---:|
| Economy | Friday | $8 |
| Standard | Thursday | $13 |
| Express | Wednesday | $22 |
| Priority | Tuesday | $35 |

### Q1

What is the speaker discussing?

(A) Shipping an item  
(B) Reserving a hotel  
(C) Purchasing equipment  
(D) Scheduling training

### Q2

What requirement does the speaker mention?

(A) The package must arrive before Friday  
(B) The fee must be below $20  
(C) Tuesday delivery is required  
(D) Economy shipping must be used

### Q3

Which service should be selected?

(A) Economy  
(B) Standard  
(C) Express  
(D) Priority

聽力稿：

> We need to send the signed contract to our partner this afternoon. They need to receive the original document no later than Thursday. There's no benefit in paying for delivery earlier than necessary, so please choose the least expensive option that guarantees arrival by then.

答案：

**1A / 2A / 3B**

符合 Thursday 或更早：

> Standard $13  
> Express $22  
> Priority $35

要求：

> least expensive

因此：

**Standard**

sections.title: ⑫ Reading｜Double Passage：規則＋更新＋例外
sections.markdown:
限時 **5 分鐘**。

### Passage 1 — Registration Policy

> **Professional Development Conference**
>
> Early registration ends October 5. Participants who register by that date pay a discounted fee of $240.
>
> Beginning October 6, the standard registration fee is $300.
>
> Registration cancellations received by October 10 qualify for a full refund. Cancellations received from October 11 through October 15 qualify for a 50-percent refund.
>
> No refunds are normally available after October 15.
>
> Participants may transfer their registration to another employee from the same organization at no additional charge, provided that the request is submitted before the conference begins on October 20.

### Passage 2 — Update from Organizer

> **To:** Registered Participants  
> **Subject:** Conference Schedule Update
>
> Due to maintenance work at the original venue, the Professional Development Conference has been moved from October 20 to October 22.
>
> All existing registrations will automatically remain valid for the new date.
>
> Participants who cannot attend because of the date change may request a full refund through October 18, regardless of the cancellation dates stated in the original registration policy.
>
> Registration transfers to another employee will also be accepted through October 21.
>
> We apologize for the inconvenience.

### Q1

What was the early registration fee?

(A) $200  
(B) $240  
(C) $300  
(D) $350

### Q2

Under the original policy, what refund is available for a cancellation on October 13?

(A) None  
(B) 25 percent  
(C) 50 percent  
(D) Full refund

### Q3

When will the conference now take place?

(A) October 18  
(B) October 20  
(C) October 21  
(D) October 22

### Q4

What happens to existing registrations?

(A) They are canceled  
(B) They remain valid  
(C) Participants must register again  
(D) They become transferable only

### Q5

A participant cannot attend because of the new date and cancels October 17. What can the participant receive?

(A) No refund  
(B) 50-percent refund  
(C) Full refund  
(D) Conference credit only

### Q6

Why is the answer to Q5 different from the original policy?

(A) The participant registered early  
(B) An updated exception overrides the original cancellation rule  
(C) The conference fee decreased  
(D) October 17 is a holiday

### Q7

Until when may a registration transfer now be requested?

(A) October 15  
(B) October 18  
(C) October 20  
(D) October 21

### 答案

**1B / 2C / 3D / 4B / 5C / 6B / 7D**

sections.title: ⑬ Reading 核心解析
sections.markdown:
今天最重要的是 Q5。

原規則：

> after Oct 15 → normally no refund

如果只看到這裡：

> Oct 17 → no refund

但是 Update 說：

> cannot attend **because of date change**  
> → full refund through Oct 18

因此：

> Oct 17 + affected by date change  
> → **full refund**

這題同時用了：

> **Timeline + Update + Exception**

可以寫成：

> Original: >15 = no refund

> Update: date-change issue + ≤18 = full refund

> User: date-change issue + 17

> → full refund

這就是 900+ Reading 的推理方式。

sections.title: ⑯ 小考重點解析
sections.markdown:
**Q1：once**

流程：

> documents received  
> ↓  
> process application

所以：

> once

---

**Q2：unless**

意思：

> 活動會繼續，**除非**天氣變危險。

---

**Q3：in case**

現在先帶：

> confirmation email

是為了預防：

> reservation problem

所以：

> **in case**

---

**Q4：provided that**

進入實驗室的條件：

> safety equipment

所以：

> **provided that**

---

**Q5**

這是今天最重要的文法陷阱：

> as soon as the manager _____

即使是在講未來：

> **makes**

不是：

> will make

完整：

> I **will notify** you as soon as the manager **makes** a decision.

sections.title: ⑱ 今日錯題分類
sections.markdown:
目前你的錯題分類已經擴展成：

| 標記 | 問題 |
|---|---|
| G | Grammar |
| V | Vocabulary |
| L | Listening |
| P | Paraphrase |
| I | Information Integration |
| T | Timeline |
| E | Exception |
| U | Updated Information |

今天再加入：

**C — Condition**

代表：

> **條件邏輯判斷錯誤**

例如：

> provided that

理解成：

> 除非

或：

> in case

理解成：

> 發生之後

都屬於 C。

之後看到錯題不要只記：

> 「Q3 錯。」

而要記：

> **Q3 — C：in case = precaution**

這樣後面的課程才能真正針對弱點調整。

sections.title: ⑳ 今日作業與後續難度調整
sections.markdown:
今天單字優先複習：

> negotiate terms  
> meet requirements  
> obtain authorization  
> meet a deadline  
> project milestone  
> monitor progress  
> finalize an agreement  
> cost estimate  
> comply with  
> renew a contract

文法建立五個反射：

> **unless = if not**

> **provided that = only if / 條件成立才可以**

> **once = 一旦**

> **as soon as = 一……立即……**

> **in case = 現在先做，預防未來可能發生**

另外把這句記熟：

> **I will call you as soon as I receive the results.**

不是：

> as soon as I will receive ❌

Listening 只留下：

> **Room：14 + video + 10–12 + smallest → Maple**

> **Project：Oct 8 impossible → Oct 11 → review revised schedule**

> **Contract：≤Thursday + cheapest → Standard**

Reading 只畫：

> Original conference = Oct 20  
> → Updated = Oct 22

> Original > Oct15 = no refund  
> → Update affected participant ≤ Oct18 = full refund

> Original transfer before Oct20  
> → Update through Oct21

今天最後重新做 Day 27 小考一次，限制 **2 分鐘**，目標 **10/10**。

難度判定採：

**10/10 且 ≤2:30** → Day 28 升至 **900+ 高密度模式**。

**8～9/10** → 維持目前難度，但增加同義改寫。

**6～7/10** → 保留 900 題型，但降低資訊量並加強弱項。

**≤5/10** → Day 28 先進行第四週核心回收，不急著增加新題型。

如果主要錯在 Q1～Q5，代表 **Condition Grammar** 需要補強；Q6～Q8 錯，代表 **Listening 多條件整合**需要補強；Q9～Q10 錯，代表目前最值得加強的是 **Timeline + Update + Exception**。

**Day 27 核心：900 分不是單純知道每句英文的意思，而是能同時判斷「條件是什麼、哪個資訊最新、是否存在例外，以及這些資訊合併後會產生什麼結果」。**

Day 28 將作為 **第四週總複習＋階段模考**：整合 Day 22～27 的 Part 4 圖表、數字、意圖、下一步，以及 Double Passage 的 Timeline / Update / Exception，並用一組限時測驗判斷第五週是否正式進入 **900+ 難度**。
